editorial:
Imagine waking up and finding out you just made a ton of money on the stock market, only to realize you just walked into a giant trap. That is exactly what happens to Hyun-soo, a regular guy who thinks he hit the jackpot. Instead of a lucky break, he gets pulled into a massive $60 million scam run by professional con artists. The vibe is like a high-stakes game of chess where nobody is who they say they are. You will feel the tension as these scammers try to outsmart each other, and the movie does a great job of making you feel just as confused and excited as the main character.

What really makes this ride fun are the constant twists that keep you guessing until the very end. The pacing is quick, and the acting is top-notch, though some of the stock market talk might feel a bit heavy at times. If you love movies where the bad guys fight each other, you will love this. It is a great pick for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the end, you find out that the biggest scam was actually a setup to catch the other scammers. After all the chasing and betraying, Hyun-soo manages to outsmart the professionals. He uses their own greed against them to secure the money for himself. The movie wraps up with the masterminds getting cheated by the person they thought was an easy target, proving that the smallest fish can sometimes eat the sharks.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves heist movies and big plot twists.
